 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. As you set your Week 10 fantasy football lineup, one under-the-radar running back option could be Miami's Ollie Gordon against the Indianapolis Colts .
 As noted by ESPN's Eric Moody , Gordon is already fairly involved in the Dolphins ' offense, recording "at least 17 touches" in each of Miami's last three games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Now, with Kyle McCord making his first NFL start while Malik Willis is on IR, that could mean even more of the Miami game plan is focused on Gordon.
 He also has a favorable matchup against the Colts ' defense.
 "Gordon hasn't scored double-digit fantasy points since Week 7, but he has had at least 17 touches in each of his past three games," wrote Moody. "That workload is encouraging heading into a favorable matchup against a defense that has allowed the eighth-most fantasy points per game to RBs."
 As a defense, the Colts are giving up 4.9 yards per carry this season, the third-highest mark in the NFL. Running backs are also averaging almost five targets in the passing game per contest against the Colts, according to CBS Sports .
 Conversely, because the Dolphins are without Willis, that could mean the Colts put more attention on the Miami run game.
 This season, Gordon has 463 rushing yards and four rushing touchdowns, along with seven receptions for 23 yards.
